objective: Proof: for a connected plane multigraph, the handlebody with one handle per vertex and, for each edge, a thickened torus attached along a curve in the class a_u a_v^-1 is a compact orientable 3-manifold whose number of homomorphisms into the symmetric group on three letters is the sum over vertex labels of the product over edges of centralizer sizes of a_u a_v^-1; repeating every edge k times and interpolating in k recovers twice the number of proper 3-colourings, which is #P-hard for planar graphs (Vertigan), so counting homomorphisms from compact 3-manifold groups into S3 is #P-hard; standard-library checks of the formula, the interpolation and controls.
status: Proved by HARD-3D-20261025-001A-P001: fin handlebodies over plane multigraphs are compact orientable 3-manifolds whose number of homomorphisms into a finite group H is the sum over vertex labels of the product of centralizer sizes of the edge differences; for S3, repeating edges and interpolating recovers twice the number of proper 3-colourings, so counting homomorphisms from compact 3-manifold groups into S3 is #P-hard (Turing; planar colouring hardness and triangulation cited); the dihedral group of order 8 gives 2^|V| P(G,4).
title: With boundary, counting maps into S3 is #P-hard
